title: BYD surges to No. 4 in Korea's imported car market
caption:
BYD has rapidly climbed the ranks in South Korea's imported car market. Despite losing access to government subsidies, the brand is now outselling most competitors.

Source: Koreaherald - BYD surges to No. 4 in Korea's imported car market
